**Verifying scheduler usage**

I think the scheduler might not be used at all. I need to verify the production call sites related to it. In my previous checks, I only noticed references in the documentation and tests for the Register function. So now, I'm planning to search the imports of the internal scheduler to see if it’s being utilized outside of its own context. It feels essential to get this confirmed!

args.command: shopt -s globstar nullglob; awk '/internal\/scheduler|scheduler\.New|scheduler\.Job|\.Register\(&scheduler\.Job/ { print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" $0 }' **/*.go

message.text:
r03.
There is no nightly database-cleanup job. The cron scheduler is only used in documentation/tests (`internal/scheduler/doc.go:12-18`; `internal/scheduler/example_test.go:15-18`); production startup registers only the 12-hour S3-presign runner (`server/server.go:153-173`; `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-36`).
